description:
"May the Forces Be With You" is an educational and fun game to learn the fundamental concepts of forces and physics. Explore how pulleys work, inclined planes, levers, magnetic forces, pendulums, gravity, etc.

Play and learn as you earn cookies to feed the cat. Develop scientific thinking, logic and curiosity. And have fun with your new friends, the cat and the robot.

With "May the Forces Be With You" you can freely play and learn, with no pressure or stress. Think, act, observe, ask questions and find answers. Have fun playing with the robot and helping him overcome challenges to win his furry friend's favorite cookies.

FEATURES

• Helps develop scientific thinking.
• Easy and intuitive scenarios, with interfaces that appeal to children.
• Includes basic concepts to understand physics: friction, gravity and magnetism.
• Discover some simple machines.
• Learn how forces work to drive pulleys, levers, inclined planes, magnets and pendulums. 
• Appropriate for children ages 4 and up. A game for the whole family. 
• No ads.

ABOUT LEARNY LAND

At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.

Privacy Policy

We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
